summary: Foundation week — all easy aerobic work, introduce movement patterns across run, bike, and strength with no intensity above Zone 2

sessions.name: Tempo Run Intro
sessions.focus: First Zone 3 tempo stimulus — aerobic sharpening

steps.description: Z1 easy shuffle, HR <145 bpm — arrive at main set warm, not fatigued
Z2 aerobic transition, HR 146-162 bpm — let HR climb naturally
Z3 tempo, HR 163-172 bpm — controlled effort, short phrases possible but not comfortable conversation
Z2 come-down, HR 146-162 bpm — do not stop, keep moving
Z1 easy walk/jog, HR back below 145 bpm

sessions.name: Sweet Spot 2x6
sessions.focus: Peak cycling stimulus — sub-threshold sweet spot intervals

steps.description: Build from Z1 to Z2, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR climbing toward 150-155 bpm by end
Sweet spot upper Z3/low Z4 boundary, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR expect 163-172 bpm in final 2 min
Easy spin recovery, let HR drop before next rep
Gradual wind-down, HR below 140 before stopping

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Peak Week
sessions.focus: Progressive lower body and core — shoulder completely unloaded
sessions.notes: 3 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg, 10x Romanian deadlift 22kg, 10x TRX split squat per leg (TRX for balance only — zero load through shoulder), 20x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug per side, 40s plank (substitute hollow body hold if any shoulder discomfort). 60s rest between rounds.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral 10 each leg, hip circles 10 each direction, bodyweight squats x15, glute bridges x15
3 rounds: goblet squat 16kg x12, RDL 22kg x10, TRX split squat x10/leg, banded glute bridge x20, dead bug x8/side, plank 40s. 60s rest between rounds.
90/90 hip stretch 45s/side, supine hamstring stretch 45s/side, pigeon pose or figure-four glute stretch 45s/side

summary: Build week — introduce first threshold/sweet-spot stimulus on the bike, extend Zone 2 running duration, progress strength loading

sessions.name: Zone 2 Run with HR Discipline
sessions.focus: Extended Zone 2 block, strict HR ceiling of 162 bpm, no Zone 3 drift

sessions.name: Sweet Spot Introduction
sessions.focus: First structured intensity — 2x5min at 140-155W, Z3 cycling stimulus

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core Build
sessions.focus: Progress load on goblet squat and RDL, add TRX split squat, maintain shoulder protection

summary: Peak week — sharpest stimulus of the block: first Zone 3 tempo running and sweet spot cycling intervals, progressive strength circuit

sessions.name: Tempo Run Intro
sessions.focus: 8 min Zone 3 tempo block inside a 30 min run — first genuine lactate stimulus

sessions.name: Sweet Spot 2x6
sessions.focus: 2x6 min at 145-160W — peak cycling intensity for the block

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core Peak
sessions.focus: Full 3-round circuit progressed from build week, goblet squat to 16kg, dead bug added

summary: Recovery week — volume cut ~40%, intensity drops to Zone 1-2 only, adaptation from the 3-week block lands here; no new stimuli

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Run
sessions.focus: Pure Zone 1-2, no tempo, HR ceiling 155 bpm — flush legs and reset

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Zone 1-2 only, 88-130W, cadence-focused, no intervals — active recovery

sessions.name: Light Mobility & Core
sessions.focus: Reduced to 2 rounds, lighter loads, emphasis on movement quality and hip mobility
